# Anoka Technical College

> > Anoka Technical College is a Minnesota State community college offering 70+ career training programs through AAS degrees, diplomas, and certificates.

Anoka Tech, founded in 1967, serves students across Anoka County with CTE education in high-demand fields like healthcare, automotive, and skilled trades. The college is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission and emphasizes equity, diversity, and student support through comprehensive enrollment services.

## Key Topics

- Career training programs
- AAS degrees and diplomas
- Financial aid (FAFSA)
- Admissions and enrollment services
- ACCUPLACER placement assessment
- PSEO and K-12 partnerships
- Healthcare programs (Medical Assistant, Surgical Technology, OTA)
- Automotive Technician programs
- Higher Learning Commission accreditation
- Minnesota State system
- Equity and diversity initiatives
- Campus location and hours
- College leadership and staff
- Academic catalog and course descriptions
